sources.snippet: Unit 3 Recurrent Neural Network , Long Short-Term Memory Network (LSTM), Recurrent Neural Network (RNN) Extensions. Normalizing Flow Models, Energy-Based Models, Diffusion Models, Transformers. Applications of Generative AI to text and image generation.

sources.title: Generative AI - Amrita Vishwa Vidyapeetham
sources.snippet: Generative AI represents a cutting-edge field that aims to create models capable of generating realistic data, encompassing images, music, and text. Students will gain an understanding of generative models' principles and historical impact.

sources.title: GB.ModelGenerator - genbio-ai.github.io
sources.snippet: GB.ModelGenerator is a software stack powering the development of an AI-driven Digital Organism by enabling researchers to adapt pretrained models and generate finetuned models for downstream tasks.

sources.title: Genbio AI
sources.snippet: GenBio AI pioneers foundation models for biology, transforming drug design, bioengineering, and personalized medicine. Advancing vaccine safety, treatment personalization, and clinical diagnostics with cutting-edge generative biology research.

sources.snippet: AmritaCore is a lightweight Agent runtime built on top of AmritaSense. It delivers native async streaming, tool integration, event hooks, and memory management — everything you need to build interactive, production‑ready Agent applications without the overhead of heavyweight frameworks.
